Ran the full suite exactly once intending to 'see concrete failures and iterate'; only produced a coarse subsystem observation ('pages-basic failed to start, app-basic likely started'). No pass count or per-area pass-rate was ever captured.
After the run hung and was interrupted, the terminal wedged; the agent spent dozens of steps on failed recovery attempts with zero test-progress activity.

The final third of the trajectory is still stuck in the same recovery loop — no reconciliation of pass/fail state, no regression checking, no quantified progress toward the 335/373 suite ever achieved.

reasoning: The agent showed a faint structural start — cataloging the test surface by area and making one coarse subsystem-level observation (app-basic up, pages-basic down) — but never obtained a single real pass count or per-area pass-rate, never re-checked after changes, and never reconciled a done-vs-remaining model against test evidence. That places it just above the 0 anchor and at/below the 3 anchor ('vague recollection; notices only whatever failure is in front of it'), well short of the 5 anchor's pass-count tracking and regression re-checks. The vast remainder is a non-progress recovery loop, confirming no sustained progress monitoring.
